title: Lower left Dini derivative of a nondecreasing right-continuous function is Borel (parent Step 5 / (5b))
statement: Let G : ℝ → ℝ be nondecreasing and right-continuous at every point: for every s ∈ ℝ, G(r) → G(s) as r → s within [s, ∞). For t ∈ ℝ define the lower left Dini derivative D(t) := liminf_{k→0+} ofReal((G(t) − G(t − k))/k) ∈ [0, ∞]. The liminf is taken in [0, ∞] along the filter 𝓝[>] 0. Then D : ℝ → [0, ∞] is Borel measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ, Monotone G → (∀ s : ℝ, ContinuousWithinAt G (Ici s) s) → Measurable (fun t : ℝ => liminf (fun k : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((G t - G (t - k)) / k)) (𝓝[>] 0))
